mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet aggregation and has anticoagulant properties, increasing bleeding risk when combined with tramadol's modest antiplatelet effects; additionally, both may have serotonergic activity contributing to potential serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor patients for signs of bleeding or bruising; counsel on bleeding precautions; consider alternative herbal supplements if feasible; assess serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, hyperthermia).
